_about: Record of a registry patch drafted on 2026-11-10 and what became of each part. This file is a proposal log, not registry data: nothing reads it, and registry.json stays the source of truth.

origin.drafted_as: registry.patch.json in a working session, sha256 52b4464f2465c22dcb9aa2e96490feae50274dbb6c97f9cfc6e8a2b74e1fe275
origin.fidelity: This file summarises the draft; it is not a copy. The applied rows were reworded, and the score and genome shapes below list field names only. The draft itself is kept byte for byte in the private ops repository.

applied_in_this_change: opencode row: overlay 'oh-my-opencode' renamed to 'oh-my-openagent (OmO; formerly oh-my-opencode)' after the upstream rename.

changed_from_the_draft.draft: Add ruflo to the oss_overlays of the claude-code, codex and grok rows and append to the claude-code decision.
changed_from_the_draft.now: One 'ruflo' row instead. The three measured rows and their recorded decisions are untouched.
changed_from_the_draft.why: Those rows carry battery results and accepted decisions. An unmeasured overlay does not belong inside them.

changed_from_the_draft.draft: opencode decision: gen_omo_config.py still emits the sisyphus-era agent roster and lacks the architect, artistry, deep-high and deep-low categories.
changed_from_the_draft.why: Wrong. The upstream schema (omo.schema.json on dev, sha256 399bae564da87590e0f851d904d6df2fb1137a419c28b3e3b3f436ded78191b0, read 2026-11-10) still names sisyphus, hephaestus, oracle, prometheus, metis, atlas, momus, librarian, explore and multimodal-looker under '[opencode]', and category names are free-form. The generated agents and categories validate. The one real defect, object entries under the reserved _migrations key, is fixed at the source of the generator.

changed_from_the_draft.draft: ruflo decision: grade Claude Code with and without `ruflo init` on the agentic battery.
changed_from_the_draft.now: Decision records the standing posture: doctrine only, runtime quarantined, first measurement is a version-pinned read-only adapter benchmark.
changed_from_the_draft.why: The estate's upstream pattern register already rules out installing the ruflo runtime ahead of that benchmark. The draft was written without having read it.

audits_table.blocked_by: The ruflo runtime is quarantined, and metaharness ships inside it. Running `npx ruflo metaharness score|genome|mcp-scan` would install and execute that runtime.
audits_table.unblocks_when: The read-only adapter benchmark has run against a pinned ruflo release and the owner lifts the quarantine for this one tool.
audits_table.idea: Store a structural fingerprint per registry entry beside its battery rows, so drift is detectable as well as performance.
